verses.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
verses.pt: Tenho-vos dito estas coisas para que não vos escandalizeis.
verses.en_web: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
verses.en_bbe: I have said these things to you so that you may not be in doubt.

verses.en: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
verses.pt: Expulsar-vos-ão das sinagogas; ainda mais, vem a hora em que qualquer que vos matar julgará prestar um serviço a Deus.
verses.en_web: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
verses.en_bbe: They will put you out of the Synagogues: yes, the time is coming when whoever puts you to death will have the belief that he is doing God's pleasure.

verses.en: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.pt: E isto vos farão, porque não conheceram ao Pai nem a mim.
verses.en_web: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.en_bbe: They will do these things to you because they have not had knowledge of the Father or of me.

verses.en: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.pt: Mas tenho-vos dito estas coisas, a fim de que, quando chegar aquela hora, vos lembreis de que eu vo-las tinha dito. Não vo-las disse desde o princípio, porque estava convosco.
verses.en_web: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.en_bbe: I have said these things to you so that when the time comes, what I have said may come to your mind. I did not say them to you at the first, because then I was still with you.

verses.en: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.pt: Agora, porém, vou para aquele que me enviou; e nenhum de vós me pergunta: Para onde vais?
verses.en_web: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
verses.en_bbe: But now I am going to him who sent me; and not one of you says to me, Where are you going?

verses.en: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.pt: Antes, porque vos disse isto, o vosso coração se encheu de tristeza.
verses.en_web: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.en_bbe: But your hearts are full of sorrow because I have said these things.

verses.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.pt: Todavia, digo-vos a verdade, convém-vos que eu vá; pois se eu não for, o Ajudador não virá a vós; mas, se eu for, vo-lo enviarei.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
verses.en_bbe: But what I am saying is true: my going is for your good: for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

verses.en: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.pt: E quando ele vier, convencerá o mundo do pecado, da justiça e do juízo:
verses.en_web: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
verses.en_bbe: And he, when he comes, will make the world conscious of sin, and of righteousness, and of being judged:

verses.en: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.pt: do pecado, porque não crêem em mim;
verses.en_web: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
verses.en_bbe: Of sin, because they have not faith in me;

verses.en: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
verses.pt: da justiça, porque vou para meu Pai, e não me vereis mais,
verses.en_web: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
verses.en_bbe: Of righteousness, because I go to the Father and you will see me no more;

verses.en: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.pt: e do juízo, porque o príncipe deste mundo já está julgado.
verses.en_web: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
verses.en_bbe: Of being judged, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

verses.en: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.pt: Ainda tenho muito que vos dizer; mas vós não o podeis suportar agora.
verses.en_web: “I have yet many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
verses.en_bbe: I have still much to say to you, but you are not strong enough for it now.

verses.en: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.pt: Quando vier, porém, aquele, o Espírito da verdade, ele vos guiará a toda a verdade; porque não falará por si mesmo, mas dirá o que tiver ouvido, e vos anunciará as coisas vindouras.
verses.en_web: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
verses.en_bbe: However, when he, the Spirit of true knowledge, has come, he will be your guide into all true knowledge: for his words will not come from himself, but whatever has come to his hearing, that he will say: and he will make clear to you the things to come.

verses.en: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.pt: Ele me glorificará, porque receberá do que é meu, e vo-lo anunciará.
verses.en_web: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
verses.en_bbe: He will give me glory, because he will take of what is mine, and make it clear to you.

verses.en: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.pt: Tudo quanto o Pai tem é meu; por isso eu vos disse que ele, recebendo do que é meu, vo-lo anunciará.
verses.en_web: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine, and will declare it to you.
verses.en_bbe: Everything which the Father has is mine: that is why I say, He will take of what is mine and will make it clear to you.

verses.en: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.pt: Um pouco, e já não me vereis; e outra vez um pouco, e ver-me-eis.
verses.en_web: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
verses.en_bbe: After a little time you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me.

verses.en: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.pt: Então alguns dos seus discípulos perguntaram uns para os outros: Que é isto que nos diz? Um pouco, e não me vereis; e outra vez um pouco, e ver-me-eis; e: Porquanto vou para o Pai?
verses.en_web: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
verses.en_bbe: So some of the disciples said one to another, What is this he is saying, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me? and, I am going to the Father?

verses.en: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
verses.pt: Diziam pois: Que quer dizer isto: Um pouco? Não compreendemos o que ele está dizendo.
verses.en_web: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
verses.en_bbe: So they said again and again, What is this he is saying, A little time? His words are not clear to us.

verses.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.pt: Percebeu Jesus que o queriam interrogar, e disse-lhes: Indagais entre vós acerca disto que disse: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e outra vez um pouco, e ver-me-eis?
verses.en_web: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’
verses.en_bbe: Jesus saw that they had a desire to put the question to him, so he said to them, Is this what you are questioning one with another, why I said, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me?

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade, vos digo que vós chorareis e vos lamentareis, mas o mundo se alegrará; vós estareis tristes, porém a vossa tristeza se converterá em alegria.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, You will be weeping and sorrowing, but the world will be glad: you will be sad, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

verses.en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.pt: A mulher, quando está para dar à luz, sente tristeza porque é chegada a sua hora; mas, depois de ter dado à luz a criança, já não se lembra da aflição, pelo gozo de haver um homem nascido ao mundo.
verses.en_web: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
verses.en_bbe: When a woman is about to give birth she has sorrow, because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the child, the pain is put out of her mind by the joy that a man has come into the world.

verses.en: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verses.pt: Assim também vós agora, na verdade, tendes tristeza; mas eu vos tornarei a ver, e alegrar-se-á o vosso coração, e a vossa alegria ninguém vo-la tirará.
verses.en_web: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
verses.en_bbe: So you have sorrow now: but I will see you again, and your hearts will be glad, and no one will take away your joy.

verses.en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
verses.pt: Naquele dia nada me perguntareis. Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que tudo quanto pedirdes ao Pai, ele vo-lo concederá em meu nome.
verses.en_web: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
verses.en_bbe: And on that day you will put no questions to me. Truly I say to you, Whatever request you make to the Father, he will give it to you in my name.

verses.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.pt: Até agora nada pedistes em meu nome; pedi, e recebereis, para que o vosso gozo seja completo.
verses.en_web: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
verses.en_bbe: Up to now you have made no request in my name: do so, and it will be answered, so that your hearts may be full of joy.

verses.en: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
verses.pt: Disse-vos estas coisas por figuras; chega, porém, a hora em que vos não falarei mais por figuras, mas abertamente vos falarei acerca do Pai.
verses.en_web: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.en_bbe: All this I have said to you in veiled language: but the time is coming when I will no longer say things in veiled language but will give you knowledge of the Father clearly.

verses.en: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.pt: Naquele dia pedireis em meu nome, e não vos digo que eu rogarei por vós ao Pai;
verses.en_web: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,
verses.en_bbe: In that day you will make requests in my name: and I do not say that I will make prayer to the Father for you,

verses.en: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
verses.pt: pois o Pai mesmo vos ama; visto que vós me amastes e crestes que eu saí de Deus.
verses.en_web: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
verses.en_bbe: For the Father himself gives his love to you, because you have given your love to me and have had faith that I came from God.

verses.en: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.pt: Saí do Pai, e vim ao mundo; outra vez deixo o mundo, e vou para o Pai.
verses.en_web: I came from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.”
verses.en_bbe: I came out from the Father and have come into the world: again, I go away from the world and go to the Father.

verses.en: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
verses.pt: Disseram os seus discípulos: Eis que agora falas abertamente, e não por figura alguma.
verses.en_web: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
verses.en_bbe: His disciples said, Now you are talking clearly and not in veiled language.

verses.en: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.pt: Agora conhecemos que sabes todas as coisas, e não necessitas de que alguém te interrogue. Por isso cremos que saíste de Deus.
verses.en_web: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
verses.en_bbe: Now we are certain that you have knowledge of all things and have no need for anyone to put questions to you: through this we have faith that you came from God.

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Credes agora?
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
verses.en_bbe: Jesus made answer, Have you faith now?

verses.en: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.pt: Eis que vem a hora, e já é chegada, em que vós sereis dispersos cada um para o seu lado, e me deixareis só; mas não estou só, porque o Pai está comigo.
verses.en_web: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.en_bbe: See, a time is coming, yes, it is now here, when you will go away in all directions, every man to his house, and I will be by myself: but I am not by myself, because the Father is with me.

verses.en: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.pt: Tenho-vos dito estas coisas, para que em mim tenhais paz. No mundo tereis tribulações; mas tende bom ânimo, eu venci o mundo.
verses.en_web: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
verses.en_bbe: I have said all these things to you so that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble: but take heart! I have overcome the world.
